{{Quote|Check it out, corporal. We'll cover you.|OWO-1, moments before his destruction|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''OWO-1''' was an [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] sent by [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to make certain that [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his apprentice, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], had been killed by a dose of deadly [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis gas]] which had previously been inserted inside the room in which the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were waiting. Leading his squad of [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|security droids]] into the gas-filled room, OWO-1 discovered that the gas had not functioned as intended, and before he could react he and the rest of his squad were [[Mission to Naboo|destroyed]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Uh oh. Blast them.|OWO-1 instructing his squad to shoot Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Episode 1" />}}
OWO-1 was created by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] some time prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid army]]. During the trade group's blockade of the planet, this droid was stationed aboard the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']], the Federation's [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class]] command ship. There, he led a squad consisting of seven [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security droids]] under the command of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] Nute Gunray.

[[File:OWO1-squad-final-moments.png|thumb|left|250px|OWO-1 and his squad, moments before being cut down]]
He and his squad were tasked with the mission of confirming the deaths of Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi by dioxis gas in the ship's conference room, with orders to blast the Jedi on sight if need be. Upon reaching the conference room, whose sole occupant appeared to be a very startled TC-14, he ordered a [[Unidentified OOM-series security droid corporal/Legends|corporal]] inside to investigate, with OWO-1 and the other security droids offering cover fire. Before the corporal could comply, two lightsabers activated in the room. OWO-1 and the corporal fired instinctively at them, only for the Jedi to deflect the blasts, [[Mission to Naboo|destroying]] both droids. The rest of the squad swiftly followed.

==Characteristics==
OWO-1 was designated from other [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|OOM-series battle droids]] by the yellow markings on his head and torso and the twin antennae mounted on his back. Using these antennae, OWO-1 could communicate with the [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] or his superiors. Like the majority of his droid type, he was equipped with a standard-issue [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster]].

==Behind the scenes==
OWO-1 first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] in [[1999]]. He was a fully computer-generated character, as were all the OOM-series battle droids in the film.
